comment: Legacy timing inventory. Wall-clock budgets and the former 120 percent regression limits are advisory under the 30 October policy; work caps remain hard. The four retained entries keep their original recorded times. References and bracket records use the local baseline identified below; drawing step 24 retains its hosted release record from https://github.com/BohnBawerick/soliddraft/actions/runs/40823628229. Ten entries were removed using sample 1 of https://github.com/BohnBawerick/soliddraft/actions/runs/41036690172; each was below 1000 ms raw and 900 ms after slow-class projection.
measured_on: local work-PC Linux x64 runner, ci-linux-local

0.5.0.measurement_context: The work PC was also running a Catallax replay during this sweep, so these are not quiet timing measurements. A separate dedicated Linux CI replay also exceeded the field_mass timing budgets in graded-fields. The other timing failures and both export timeouts remain unresolved.

0.6.0.measurement_context: The work PC ran no Catallax replay during this sweep. The two export timeouts and the first 13 timing failures match 0.5.0. draft-oblique-pull is a new scenario whose draft and reopen steps took 1.6 to 2.1 s. sketch-fillet-chamfer-split took 1.56 to 1.65 s for one requested measurement in four runs, under the 2 s gate. It was not in the 0.5.0 sweep; in five alternating runs on the same machine, 0.5.0 took 1.56 to 1.85 s on that step and 0.6.0 took 1.75 to 1.88 s, so the budget overrun predates 0.6.0.

0.7.0.measurement_context: The work-PC sweep ran all 123 scenarios once with --strict: 121 passed functional checks and 106 passed the strict verdict. The 15 timing failures and the two incomplete STL exports are not passes. Opening the saved owner-fillet part in the downloaded browser build exceeded the 180-second wait, and a later inspection timed out; that part is not yet proven in the browser. The owner six-edge pocket rim at R2 and the twelve-edge box at R2 built and exported STEP through the release command layer, and both exports passed the independent raw OpenCASCADE 8 check. The downloaded AppImage produced no requested screenshot after ten minutes and its MCP initialization returned HTTP 503; installed double-click opening remains unverified in headless validation. After the sweep, the fixture-only source-pair correction passed all four real-renderer fillet preview cases at e166dc52afb662740a930fb0ca58b347cbb1ea10, with the oracle and tolerances unchanged.
